description: Scope: named release startup only; defer lazy provider infrastructure lifecycle. Action reuse assessment: local-only OTP composition, reuse existing Channels supervisor option forwarding and WebBridge adapter_options; no business Action or agent tool is appropriate. Add regression tests before implementation for single-node named startup, membership overrides, invalid explicit membership, provider isolation and unchanged authentication settings. Supply widget default replica_nodes [node()] at runtime only when omitted, and wire application-configured channels_supervisor_options through Zaq.Application. Document explicit identical widget replica membership for multi-node widget deployments, never Node.list discovery. Preserve existing assertions. Validate isolated tests, mix q and final mix precommit.
title: Restore named-node widget startup with host-supplied topology
